title: From nighttime lights rasters to an econometrics-ready panel
text: code run vignette built. needs NASA Earthdata token EARTHDATA_TOKEN region boundaries 2022 vintage (17 regions plus cities national significance). monthly Black Marble tile roughly 50-130 MB Kazakhstan needs 10 , loop downloads one year time clears cache year. commit long monthly series, run system.file("scripts", "validate_splice_kz.R", package = "ntlpanel"). checks tile orientation whether Suomi NPP NOAA-20 shift stable across Kazakhstan’s regions seasons.
code: library(sf) # your boundaries, with an identifier column "region" regions <- st_read("kz_adm1_2022.gpkg") ntl_tiles(regions)                             # 10 tiles: h22-h26, v03-v04  extract_year <- function(product, year) {   m <- ntl_fetch(product, aoi = regions, start = paste0(year, "-01"),                  end = paste0(year, "-12"))   out <- ntl_extract(m, regions, id_col = "region", quality_max = 1)   ntl_cache_clear(m)   out } snpp <- lapply(2014:2026, function(y) extract_year("VNP46A3", y)) j01 <- lapply(2018:2026, function(y) extract_year("VJ146A3", y)) long <- do.call(rbind, c(snpp, j01))  sp <- ntl_splice(long, from = "VNP46A3", to = "VJ146A3",                  by_month = TRUE, min_share_valid = 0.8) ntl_splice_report(sp)  p <- ntl_panel(sp, min_share_valid = 0.6) p <- ntl_gapfill(p,   rule = "interp", max_gap = 2, units = regions, lat_threshold = 45 )

Every observation records much unit actually observed. steps usually happen silently script become explicit recorded: Sensor continuity. NOAA ended Suomi NPP data delivery 2 November 2026. ntl_splice() puts Suomi NPP (VNP46) NOAA-20 (VJ146) one scale reports level shifts per unit, optionally per calendar month. Coverage. ntl_extract() reports share_valid, share_masked mean_obs unit period, keeps “dark” (0) separate “unobserved” (NA). ntl_gapfill() applies documented rule high-latitude summer gaps flags cells risk. Units design. ntl_crosswalk() moves official statistics boundary vintages, example Kazakhstan’s 2022 regions. ntl_exposure() assigns distance rings first-treatment dates staggered difference--differences designs.

text: workflow five steps: Find fetch data. ntl_sources() lists supported products. ntl_fetch() downloads NASA Black Marble tiles (Suomi NPP VNP46A3/A4 NOAA-20 VJ146A3/A4) cache. ntl_files() indexes files already (EOG VNL composites, harmonized DMSP-VIIRS series, Black Marble .h5 files). return manifest. Extract. ntl_extract() reads one period time, applies quality, coverage gas-flare masks (ntl_mask()) computes zonal statistics coverage diagnostics (ntl_aggregate()). Splice sensors. ntl_splice() puts Suomi NPP NOAA-20 (two series) one scale reports level shifts per unit. Build panel. ntl_panel() balances unit x period grid adds transforms time indices. ntl_gapfill() applies explicit rules missing low-coverage cells, summer stray-light gaps high latitudes. Add design variables. ntl_exposure() assigns distance rings first-treatment dates. ntl_crosswalk() ntl_apply_crosswalk() move tabular data boundary vintages.

text: First version. Data access: ntl_sources(), ntl_tiles(), ntl_available(), ntl_fetch() (NASA Black Marble VNP46A3/A4 NOAA-20 VJ146A3/A4 LAADS, caching, integrity checks manifests), ntl_files() (EOG VNL monthly annual composites, harmonized DMSP-VIIRS series, local Black Marble files).
